programme.desc: Berg yang percaya dia pernah melihat UFO bertahun dulu, mengembara bersama rakan-rakannya merentasi Malaysia untuk membuat filem mengenainya. Tanpa sedari perjalanan itu lebih dari apa yang kelihatan.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Kahwin Kahwin

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Kekasih Elektrik
programme.desc: Amri, seorang novelis dikunjungi oleh seorang gadis misteri yang muncul secara tiba-tiba di kedainya. Namun, hanya dia sahaja yang boleh melihat gadis tersebut yang juga kehilangan memori. Mereka bersama-sama mencari klu siapakah gadis tersebut.

programme.title: Aisah Lima Puluh Sen
programme.desc: Inilah kisah hidup Aisah seorang insan istimewa yang hanya tahu 2 perkara dalam hidupnya iaitu 'Remy' dan duit syiling 50 sen!

programme.title: New York Cinta
programme.desc: Mia melanjutkan pelajaran ke Amerika Syarikat untuk mendalami bidang muzik namun ditakdirkan dia bertemu dengan Seth lalu jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Lesen Besar
programme.desc: Tiga sekawan yang rindu zaman bujang mereka telah merancang untuk pergi 'road trip' setelah mendapat pelepasan daripada isteri dan teman wanita masing-masing. Tapi nasib tidak menyebelahi mereka di sepanja

programme.title: Duyung
programme.desc: Sebuah filem cereka fantasi yang mengisahkan tentang persahabatan dan percintaan seorang pemuda kampung dengan se'orang' ikan duyung. Dibintangi oleh Maya Karin, Saiful Apek, Yasmin Hani Richardson dan Yassin.

programme.desc: Yatim Mustapha

programme.desc: Qais dan Laila saling jatuh cinta semasa kecil, tetapi apabila mereka dewasa ayah Laila menghalang mereka untuk bersama.

programme.desc: Kisah komedi asam garam rumahtangga Wahid & Pak Dollah yang suka menggoda wanita lain menyebabkan mereka dikawal oleh isteri mereka.

programme.title: My Spy
programme.desc: Ikuti gandingan lucu AJ dan Salleh dalam aksi mereka dalam menyelesaikan kes penyeledupan lukisan yang amat berharga. Lakonan AC Mizal & Harun Salim Bachik.

programme.title: Bunga dan Kayu
programme.desc: Takdir mempertemukan Bunga dan Noah di jalan raya dan di hotel tempat Bunga bekerja. Apakah pertemuan itu memberi makna kepada mereka berdua?

programme.title: Cinta Sambal Belacan
programme.desc: Angah sering kalah kepada Aini di dalam satu pertandingan memasak. Angah cuba mencari bahan rahsia yang sering digunakan oleh Aini di dalam masakannya & cuba mengalahkan Aini namun tanpa sedar dia mula men

programme.title: Boss
programme.desc: Kisah 3 orang gadis penyiasat persendirian yang cuba untuk melumpuhkan sebuah sindiket jahat yang diketuai oleh Malik.

programme.title: Janda Meletup
programme.desc: Dengan bantuan bomoh, Kamil telah berjaya memikat Rosnah seorang janda muda namun keputusan Rosnah untuk berhijrah ke Kuala Lumpur telah membuat Kamil kecewa. Lakonan Salih Yaacob dan Rozie Rashid.

programme.title: Lukisan
programme.desc: Kisah Amir, seorang budak kampung yang cuba merungkai misteri di sebalik jeritan Piah, gadis yang tinggal berhampiran rumahnya yang dikatakan gila dan selalu berhalusinasi. Dapatkah rahsia itu dibongkar?

programme.title: Main Kahwin Kahwin
programme.desc: Impian perkahwinan Nina musnah kerana kecurangan tunangnya. Sahabatnya Azam mencadangkan Nina untuk merancang perkahwinannya seperti ‘main kahwin kahwin’ ketika zaman kanak-kanak mereka.

programme.title: Oh Mak Kau
programme.desc: Sam dan Mun adalah dua perompak. Ketika wanita kegemaran mereka kembali ke kampung dari bandar, keduanya menghadapi pengalaman yang mengubah hidup di tengah persaingan untuk memikat hati sang wanita.

programme.title: Kimchi Untuk Awak
programme.desc: Bella, pelajar universiti di Korea Selatan pulang ke Malaysia untuk menghabiskan cuti semester tetapi ketenangan mula bertukar menjadi huru-hara selepas bertemu dengan lelaki Melayu-Korea bernama Daniel.

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Kisah Notti seorang jin perempuan yang comel lagi baik hati dicampakkan ke muka bumi supaya dia dapat belajar dari sikap ramai manusia yang jahat. Dibintangi oleh Fara Fauzana, Mawi dan Cat Farish.

programme.title: Cinta Kura-Kura
programme.desc: Seekor kura-kura yang boleh bercakap cuba membantu seorang gadis untuk mendapatkan calon kekasih yang sesuai buatnya. Lakonan Tizz Zaqyah & Zizan Razak.

PENGISIAN LAGU-LAGU POPULAR RETRO DENGAN SEGMEN LUAHAN KAKAK ABANG, RESEPI MANJA-MANJA JE DAN DRAMA DALAM KERETA (RABU & KHAMIS). SEGMAN BIS ON AIR JUGA AKAN BERSIARAN PADA 6.00 PETANG SERTA INFO DAN TOPIK SEMASA YANG MENARIK SEMASA PEMANDUAN. JUGA BERSIARAN MENERUSI LIVE TIK TOK NASIONALfm. DENGARKAN PENGISIAN PROGRAM AGAMA RAUDHAH.

programme.title: NASIONAL MALAM.
programme.desc: SANTAI MALAM BERSAMA PENYAMPAI AJ, REDZA DAN AIZAT DENGAN LAGU-LAGU HITS DAN POPULAR. SEGMEN PILIHAN BERSAMA MENANTI PENDENGAR MENERUSI FB DAN TIK TOK LIVE NASIONALfm. SLOT KAUNTER ARTIS BERSAMA ARTIS DAN SELEBRITI POPULAR SETIAP HARI RABU 9.15 MALAM - 10 MALAM.\n

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: Mat So'od
programme.desc: Mat So'od merupakan penglipurlara di kampungnya. Namun berlawanan dengan kerjayanya, Mat So'od merupakan seorang pemurung hampir sepanjang hidupnya.

programme.title: Perkahwinan Dari ...
programme.desc: Pasangan selebriti terkenal di Malaysia, Asha dan Mal terdesak untuk menjaga rahsia perkahwinan mereka dari diketahui oleh pengurus mereka, Feek.

programme.title: Kipas Belum Mati
programme.desc: Mia, seorang artis meningkat naik, membuka kelab peminatnya dan dibantu oleh Lynn yang menjadi pengurus. Dengan bantuan Lynn, kelabnya maju namun ada harga yang harus dibayar di sebalik kejayaan tersebut..

programme.title: Geng
programme.desc: Isabella is an ex-convict who has sworn off her life of crime. Unfortunately, her old gang boss wants her to do one last drug transaction and kidnaps her mother to blackmail Isabella. With the help of her high school best friends, Mariam and Anita, Isabella goes on a road trip to save her mother.

programme.title: Keabadian Cinta
programme.desc: 3 couples falls in love with each other in 3 different love stories.

programme.title: Boyfriend Aku Dari ...
programme.desc: After being disappointed multiple times, Risya is introduced by a friend to Andy, a nerdy young man. They fall in love but in actuality, Andy is a boyfriend from 'hell'!

programme.title: Gengster Leng Chai
programme.desc: Black is a failure of a gangster, being too soft hearted with people. After meeting Mawar, he is determined to change despite the objections of others.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap Sesat Kat Paris
programme.desc: Nini and Haikal start their big adventure to find their aunty Lisa who gets a job offer as a professional photographer in Paris. Unfortunately, their journey turns upside down when they arrive in Paris and ruin a newly-wed coupleís honeymoon.

programme.title: Nota Silam
programme.desc: Munirah menjumpai sebuah nota cinta di dalam sebuah buku yang diperolehi secara rambang dari 'blind date with a book' dan cuba untuk menemukan pasangan di dalam nota tersebut yang merubah hidup Munirah

programme.title: Bukan Cerita Cinta Cliche
programme.desc: Seorang penulis skrip kisah-kisah cinta tetapi masih bersendirian mengimpikan cinta dalam kehidupan realitinya, lalu dia menyertai sebuah kumpulan terapi untuk berkongsi masalah peribadinya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: Dee The Series
programme.desc: Dee bersama adik dan ibunya Amy, memulakan hidup baru di KL apabila Amy mendapat kerja baru di sebuah kolej swasta. Bermulalah satu dunia baru untuk Dee yang penuh dengan muzik, gelak ketawa dan air mata.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap
programme.desc: Nini dan Haikal iaitu adik beradik tiri menjadi bosan apabila asyik bertukar rumah, justeru mereka merancang untuk menyatukan Hairi dan Lisa iaitu penjaga sementara mereka.

programme.title: Super Game Boy The Series (Astro Ceria)
programme.desc: Danial dan kawan-kawannya Ayu, Bob dan Nina kembali beraksi dengan gelagat mereka yang lucu dan menarik. Berjayakah misi mereka di dalam setiap episod? Jom kita saksikannya.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini uses the fresh ingredients from rich Tuscan soil to make regional dishes like Spinach Ricotta Gnudi.

programme.title: Le Marche
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini explores classic dishes from the central Italian region, Le Marche.

programme.title: Abruzzo
programme.desc: The secluded region of Abruzzo makes for unique Italian cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini shows us diverse regional recipes like Rolled Meat Crepes.

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Pasta, bread, pizza dough! Host Michael Bonacini makes Apulian classics like Artichoke Cheese Panzerotti.

programme.title: Lazio
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Calabria
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Campania
programme.desc: The Italian region Campania is known for its seafood and pizza. Famed Chef Michael Bonacini prepares classics like Margherita Pizza and Fried Seafood.

programme.title: Umbria
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Lombardy
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini prepares traditional dishes from the Northern Italian region, Lombardy.

programme.title: Emilia Romagna
programme.desc: Emilia Romagna is the culinary heart of Italy and Chef Michael Bonacini shows viewers how to make some of the region's most delicious dishes.

programme.title: Umbria

programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Deadly Medicine
programme.desc: Dr. Harold 'Fred' Shipman was known as a dedicated, hardworking and community-minded doctor who spent his life gaining the trust of his patients and the respect of his colleagues. And for 25 years, nobody suspected that the town doctor was amassing a death toll that would make him one of history’s most prolific serial killers. The local undertaker is among the first to notice a strange pattern. Shipman’s patients seem to be dying at an unusually high rate, and their dead bodies had a similarity when he called to collect them – almost all were elderly women who lived alone and they died sitting in chairs while fully clothed. "There was never anything in the house that I saw that indicated the person had been ill," the undertaker remembers. "It just seems the person, where they were, had died. There was something that didn’t quite fit." Shipman is found guilty and given fifteen life sentences. A clinical audit commissioned by the Department of Health estimates Shipman is responsibility for the deaths of at least 236 patients over a 24-year period, although unofficial estimates put the number between 400 and 1,000.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death’s door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore’s symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore’s vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore’s two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death’s door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore’s symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore’s vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore’s two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.title: The Speed record
programme.desc: MewMew has a new stopwatch and wants to time everything that everyone does, to get to them to do it at record speed. Life in Abra-Dabra becomes intolerable as everyone tries to be quicker than the next person. Eventually Deedee and the others persuade MewMew to break all his speed records. He also realises that by doing everything fast, he is missing out on enjoying many things.

programme.title: Doobydoo Meep Concert
programme.desc: The annual Doobydoo Meep concert is about to take place, and Charlie wants to practice one last time before heading out. So Deedee chips in by agreeing to follow specific instructions to organise the difficult to manage Doobydoos but also promises not to use magic for anything at all. Deedee mixes up the sandwiches for the Doodyboos with the recorders that she ends up sending off with Mewmew. Nino constantly keeps Deedee in check so that she doesn’t back out of her promise. Mewmew is having a tough time organising with the Doobydoos while Deedee finds out Charlie has slept of practising. The concert goes well, but they all decide they won’t have lullabies ever again.

programme.title: Where is it?
programme.desc: During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

programme.title: Meep Meep Charlie's
programme.desc: Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. They find a way to get the twins to work together and splash the Doobydoos with water and wash off the friendship dust. The twins are friends again even though Deedee’s magic didn’t work as expected.

programme.title: Where is it?
programme.desc: During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

programme.title: Meep Meep Charlie's
programme.desc: Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. They find a way to get the twins to work together and splash the Doobydoos with water and wash off the friendship dust. The twins are friends again even though Deedee’s magic didn’t work as expected.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E68
programme.desc: Berenice reclama a Israel que nunca le haya querido lo suficiente; la abrumada mujer decreta que odia a su padre por haberle destruido la vida.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E017
programme.desc: Nicolás recibe la llamada que espera de la persona que lo va a ayudar en su venganza contra Hilario. Yosmir le pide dinero prestado a Isaura con la excusa de que es para un negocio, pero Chabeto lo pone en evidencia ante la señora asegurando que la plata es para salir con una novia, Eugenia ve su plan para salir con Yosmir desvanecerse cuando Fernanda le recuerda que tienen un compromiso en el club. Victoria se espanta al descubrir que Nicolás tenía razón, pues todos los novillos que acaba de comprar Hilario se murieron apenas el hombre cerró el trato. Jonás, manipulador, le reprocha a Antonieta que haya dudado de su amor y le muestra las fotos de todos los terrenos que ha pensado en comprar para que construyan su casa una vez que se casen.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E018
programme.desc: Hilario queda sorprendido al enterarse que Victoria ha decidido regresar a la ciudad con Hansen pues, según ella, debe ir en busca de su verdad. Nicolás asegura a Fernanda que avisarle a Victoria lo que iba a pasar con los novillos era parte de su plan para ganarse su confianza. Victoria le pide a Adelaida que le diga si es cierto que Hilario mató a Jaimito Del Casal; la señora asegura a su hija que ella cree en la inocencia de su esposo aunque Fernanda no comparta su opinión y la insta a decidir si va a creer o no en su padre. Clementina aconseja a Victoria que se busque otro enamorado que la ayude a olvidarse de Nicolás.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E115
programme.desc: Ezequiel recibe una nota de El Doliente, anticipándole su muerte. El plan contra Rosa Blanco falló. Continúa relatando los hechos del pasado; Ezequiel, obligándola a tomar el arma homicida, logró que fuera culpada por éste asesinato, por el que pagó tantos años de cárcel injusta.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E116
programme.desc: Ezequiel trata de abusar de Camila, una mano enguantada lo golpea. Todos culpan a Camila y ella se defiende diciendo que no vio al asesino. Torrealba insiste en interrogarla. Todos: Octavia, Astrid, Max, Marcelina, Leandro, Gregorio y hasta Sebastián tenían motivos para matar a Ezequiel. Sólo queda detenido Max, como presunto autor material del hecho.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E005 - Episode 5
programme.desc: Carlos Alfredo trata de humillar a Cheíto frente a sus amigos, pero sale victorioso de dicha prueba. Rosalba decide contarle a Mariana toda la verdad de su enfermedad. Abigail y Matilda llegan a la cita pero la situación se sale de control.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E006 - Episode 6
programme.desc: Matilde se encuentra en el quirófano mientras Abigail angustiada le confiesa la verdad a Freddy. Cheíto decide escribirle una carta de amor a Mariana después de verla besando a Juan Carlos. María Begoña le propone a Carlos Alfredo deshacerse de Cheíto.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E13
programme.desc: Elvis le plantea a Virginia lo del aborto. Movida por la vergüenza ante su madre y el temor a no saber cómo enfrentar un embarazo, Virginia acepta. Lorena se debate entre decirle toda la verdad a Marco Aurelio o seguir calando, teme por la vida de Ignacio.

Pablo ve fotos de Malena con Alfonso y ordena continuar el seguimiento, pues serán pruebas que presentará para quitarle el niño. Lorena le muestra una foto de Guillermo a Marco Aurelio en su celular y él lo identifica sin lugar a dudas como el sicario que trató de matarlo.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E68
programme.desc: Berenice reclama a Israel que nunca le haya querido lo suficiente; la abrumada mujer decreta que odia a su padre por haberle destruido la vida.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E69
programme.desc: Al anochecer, el comisario DAZA pretende llevar detenida a Clara Inés por usurpación de identidad, Nicolás lo defiende.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E018
programme.desc: Hilario queda sorprendido al enterarse que Victoria ha decidido regresar a la ciudad con Hansen pues, según ella, debe ir en busca de su verdad. Nicolás asegura a Fernanda que avisarle a Victoria lo que iba a pasar con los novillos era parte de su plan para ganarse su confianza. Victoria le pide a Adelaida que le diga si es cierto que Hilario mató a Jaimito Del Casal; la señora asegura a su hija que ella cree en la inocencia de su esposo aunque Fernanda no comparta su opinión y la insta a decidir si va a creer o no en su padre. Clementina aconseja a Victoria que se busque otro enamorado que la ayude a olvidarse de Nicolás.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E019
programme.desc: Fernanda impide que Nicolás siga espiando la conversación entre Jonás y Builder. Una emocionada Antonieta comenta con Fernanda que existe la posibilidad de salir en la película que va a filmar Jack aunque sea como extra, cosa que la hace muy feliz, pues todas sus amigas de la alta sociedad se van a morir de envidia.Victoria se finge furiosa ante Adelaida al recibir un ramo de flores que le envía Nicolás, aunque, a solas, admite que se muere por perdonarlo.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E116
programme.desc: Ezequiel trata de abusar de Camila, una mano enguantada lo golpea. Todos culpan a Camila y ella se defiende diciendo que no vio al asesino. Torrealba insiste en interrogarla. Todos: Octavia, Astrid, Max, Marcelina, Leandro, Gregorio y hasta Sebastián tenían motivos para matar a Ezequiel. Sólo queda detenido Max, como presunto autor material del hecho.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E15
programme.desc: Omar sospecha que Marco Aurelio tiene información que no revela, pero el hábil abogado no se delata. Omar y el Jefe de Policía descartan la posibilidad de que sea gente vinculada a un cártel los que estén detrás del intento de asesinato de Marco Aurelio. Claudio le promete a Lorena entregarle personalmente a Ignacio si acaba con la vida de su hermano. Lorena sostiene el arma, buscando fuerzas para accionarla.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E16
programme.desc: Paulina defiende a Elvis tildando a Virginia de cualquiera, poniendo en duda incluso que el bebé que espera sea de su hijo. Alberto le informa a Lorena la decisión de Patricia de no seguir con su caso. Marco Aurelio le dice a Lorena que ahora es él quien necesita un favor de ella, y le pide que averigüe con su ex pareja quiénes son los autores intelectuales de sus atentados. Lorena tensa y asustada, porque ella sabe muy bien sus nombres: Gertrudis y Claudio.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E69
programme.desc: Al anochecer, el comisario DAZA pretende llevar detenida a Clara Inés por usurpación de identidad, Nicolás lo defiende.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E70
programme.desc: Octavia promete a Clara Inés que probará su inocencia y una autentica Santa María; Clara ya no tiene interés en demostrar que es de la familia.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E019
programme.desc: Fernanda impide que Nicolás siga espiando la conversación entre Jonás y Builder. programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E020
programme.desc: Eugenia se siente incómoda cuando Miguel evidencia que gusta de ella y asegura estar dispuesto a conquistarla. Clementina le entrega a Victoria un ramo de flores que acaba de traerle un mensajero y que le envía Builder; la joven Guanipa evidencia preferir el de Nicolás. Nicolás se presenta en casa de Carmencita a avisarle a Victoria lo ocurrido a Hilario; la muchacha advierte que ya estaba enterada y que a su padre no le pasó nada antes de reprocharle el beso que le estuvo dando a Liliana esa mañana y que ella vio en una foto. Nicolás busca a Victoria en la universidad para asegurarle que está dispuesto a hacer cualquier cosa por reconquistarla, pues para él no existe más nadie; Guanipa, orgullosa, lo trata con cierto desprecio y, frente a él, llama a Builder para aceptar la invitación que le hiciera anteriormente.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E117
programme.desc: Max detenido y Camila asegura que es inocente. Santiago le cuenta al inspector haber visto a Max limpiando el objeto con el que mataron a Ezequiel y, con tristeza concluye que él y Camila fueron los autores. Continúan los interrogatorios.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E118
programme.desc: Torrealba expone ante dos oficiales el caso del crimen de Ezequiel López Méndez, es interrumpido por Marcelina que viene a confesarse culpable, Torrealba no le cree. Rosa acusa a Octavia de ser la que ideó abandonar a Camila y convenció a Marcelina de que lo hiciere. Octavia se burla y Camila, ciega de ira la bota de su casa.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E007 - Episode 7
programme.desc: Carlos Alfredo se molesta cuando se entera que Abigail se encuentra en casa de Cheíto y le reclama a Pastora que siempre la proteja. Lucía llama a María Clara y le confiesa toda la verdad sobre su hermana gemela, sin darse cuenta que la está escuchando.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E008 - Episode 8

Patricia le confiesa a Alberto que lo ama.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E021
programme.desc: Una vez que Hansen los deja a solas; Hilario avisa a Adelaida que la perdona y le exige que regrese a su lado. Yosmir se molesta cuando Eugenia asegura que cree que si van a poder ser amigos, pues siente que ya perdió la oportunidad de conquistarla. Victoria le pide a Carmencita que le lea las cartas para que le dé algunas respuestas; la señora solo llega a decirle que hay dos hombres que la rondan, que uno de ellos oculta algo y que la única manera en que va a lograr salvarse es perdonando. Hilario busca a Victoria para pedirle que lo perdone por haberla tratado mal cuando ella es lo más bonito que tiene en su vida; la joven se conmueve de ver a su papá entristecido, pero se sorprende cuando le pide que le jure, que nunca más va a ver a Nicolás Del Casal.

programme.desc: Una vez que Hansen los deja a solas; Hilario avisa a Adelaida que la perdona y le exige que regrese a su lado. Yosmir se molesta cuando Eugenia asegura que cree que si van a poder ser amigos, pues siente que ya perdió la oportunidad de conquistarla. Victoria le pide a Carmencita que le lea las cartas para que le dé algunas respuestas; la señora solo llega a decirle que hay dos hombres que la rondan, que uno de ellos oculta algo y que la única manera en que va a lograr salvarse es perdonando. Hilario busca a Victoria para pedirle que lo perdone por haberla tratado mal cuando ella es lo más bonito que tiene en su vida; la joven se conmueve de ver a su papá entristecido, pero se sorprende cuando le pide que le jure, que nunca más va a ver a Nicolás Del Casal.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E118
programme.desc: Torrealba expone ante dos oficiales el caso del crimen de Ezequiel López Méndez, es interrumpido por Marcelina que viene a confesarse culpable, Torrealba no le cree. Rosa acusa a Octavia de ser la que ideó abandonar a Camila y convenció a Marcelina de que lo hiciere. Octavia se burla y Camila, ciega de ira la bota de su casa.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E17
programme.desc: Guillermo le dice a Lorena que será él quien se encargue de ahora en adelante de la crianza de Ignacio. Lorena, sin soportar más la presión a la que está sometida, le grita a Guillermo que ella no es capaz de matar a nadie, que la libere de esa responsabilidad que no le corresponde. Patricia le confiesa a Alberto que lo ama.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E18
programme.desc: Lorena le confiesa a Marco Aurelio que su hermano y su esposa son los autores intelectuales de los atentados en su contra. Elvis hace un último intento por conseguir que Virginia se tome las pastillas abortivas. Malena, descubre varias fotos de ella en la casa de Isabel. Malena acude a Patricia para que la divorcie de Pablo - Marco Aurelio siente el impulso de contarle lo que sabe a Alberto, pero Lorena lo convence de guardar silencio hasta que él mismo pueda comprobar lo que le acaba de confiar.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E71
programme.desc: Clara Inés pregunta a Anastasio si él cree que la Pastora que se casó con Israel en el pasado sea la misma mujer presente, él se extraña.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E022
programme.desc: Hilario quiere que Victoria se olvide para siempre de Nicolás convencido de que el joven la está utilizando para vengarse de él. programme.title: Dropped - S05:E07 - Cache Out
programme.desc: With red meat, the Keefer brothers are finally able to replenish their depleted energy, but they aren't the only ones looking to survive the winter in the Alaskan wilderness.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E08 - Bearing Down
programme.desc: The harsh reality of winter sets in, and the Keefer brothers are forced to sleep with one eye open as a grizzly patrols the area around their camp.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E01 - Whitefish Rodeo Part 1
programme.desc: Michigan Conservation Officers sometimes dress in everyday clothes to blend in while monitoring if fishermen are illegally snagging fish.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E02 - Whitefish Rodeo Part 2
programme.desc: Part two of a night time patrol to stop Michigan anglers from keeping fish that are foul-hooked or snagged.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E02 - Nature's World Wide Web
programme.desc: When animals share info to help each other decide, it's called animal communication. They use stuff like sounds, colors, body language, movements, electric signs, touches, smells, or a mix of these. Whether it's a sea anemone spreading its tentacles or a male lion considering approaching a mate, their skill in communicating can be vital for their success. This episode dives into how animals interact with one another.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E03 - Salvage: Gone-Awry
programme.desc: Joel and Mark Barker tempt fate and fly into no man's land to find and salvage a white airplane in a snowy forest all while fighting hypothermia along the way.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E04 - Heaven at 5000 Feet
programme.desc: Pilot Josiah Freeman takes a professional snowboarder Mark Barajas to the top of the Chugach Mountains for some hellacious heli-skiing.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S07:E04 - Ripon Workhouse
programme.desc: Karl and Stuart visit Ripon's old Victorian workhouse, a place that has seen much misery, death, and paranormal activity.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S07:E05 - Shrewsbury Prison
programme.desc: Yvette initiates the solo investigation while Karl and Stuart team up in A-Wing. Her error becomes clear when an old guard's spirit arrives.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E04 - Heaven at 5000 Feet
programme.desc: Pilot Josiah Freeman takes a professional snowboarder Mark Barajas to the top of the Chugach Mountains for some hellacious heli-skiing.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E34 - Prince William And Prince Harry The Next Royal Generation
programme.desc: Prince William and Prince Harry, along with their friends, got as much media attention as today’s pop stars, fashion icons, and movie celebs. This documentary explores how this affected their personal lives and friendships, showcasing how they managed their fame alongside their royal responsibilities.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share similar interests and seem like a perfect match. Both have faced tough times growing up but have come out on top. Now they're winning together. This hour-long special, featuring a chat with author Andrew Morton, explores the social backdrop that makes their bold marriage fit right in with today's British Royal Family.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E03 - The Secret Lives of Pumas
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Pumas are also known by the names of cougar or mountain lion. However, these cats are only distantly related to lions. They're much more closely related to cheetahs. And while pumas are often found in mountains, they're just as at home in the lowlands, dense forests, treeless pampers, or deserts.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E04 - The Secret Lives of Lions
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Lions differ from all other cats in that they are highly social, forming prides of up to 35 animals. There are now thought to be fewer than 15,000 lions remaining in Kenya's Masai Mara, a drop of 75% in 50 years.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E06 - The Secret Lives of Jaguars
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. The first jaguar scientists struggled to go anywhere near their subjects. But times have changed. There are now a couple of places in the world where seeing a wild jaguar is a possibility rather than a dream.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E66 - Secrets Of A Dog's Nose
programme.desc: A dog's sense of smell can do amazing things. Dogs can help humans sniff out all kinds of things that improve our lives, explosives, missing persons, illegal drugs. Now the latest research is revealing that dogs can detect disease, even cancer.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E03 - Cunning Copulation
programme.desc: Finding a mate, building a nest, and raising kids are all part of the whole reproductive behavior thing. But it’s not as easy as it sounds. First, you’ve got to sift through lots of possible partners to find the one with the best genes to keep your family line going. Nesting involves finding some space and then guarding it fiercely, while raising the little ones takes loads of energy as you have to feed, teach, and keep them safe until they grow up. This episode dives into the ins and outs of how creatures go about their reproductive business.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E04 - Battle Plans
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild often means being able to fight and win. This fighting strategy is called agonism and is used to set ranks, get resources, claim territory, and attract partners. There's no certainty in the wild, but animals that get good at agonism have a better shot at living to see another day.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E07 - Naturally Fascinating
programme.desc: Bolivia is a country of countless fascinating natural sights. We will begin on the high plateau of Altiplano, stopping by the world’s largest salt lake.Later, we will descend a few thousand meters using the road of death to the Los Yungas province. And then on to the shores of lake Titicaca, the highest navigable lake in the world.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E08 - Naturally Harmonious
programme.desc: Zambia, the Latvian region of Kurzeme, the Georgian provinces of Kakheti and Svaneti, seem to have very little in common. They lie in Africa, Europe and on the borderline between Europe and Asia respectively. Kakheti and Svaneti are both a part of Georgia but very unlike one another. So where is the connection? How are these regions similar?

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E09 - Naturally Spiritual
programme.desc: In this episode we visit two different corners of our planet. Although thousands of kilometres apart, spiritually they are close relatives. First, Ethiopia in East Africa which is dissected by the Great African Rift Valley and considered by many to be the cradle of humankind. Next, a paradise on Earth: Jamaica.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. With never-before-seen footage, it shows her path from a shy teen to becoming the beloved Diana, Princess of Wales, including touching moments from her last days.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E04 - Battle Plans
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild often means being able to fight and win. This fighting strategy is called agonism and is used to set ranks, get resources, claim territory, and attract partners. There's no certainty in the wild, but animals that get good at agonism have a better shot at living to see another day.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E44 - 50 Glorious Years A Royal Celebration
programme.desc: Honoring 50 years of marriage between Her Majesty the Queen and her husband, Prince Philip of Greece and Denmark, the Duke of Edinburgh.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. Her hats were another standout feature; she often wore elegant designs that added a touch of grace to her look. Her hair was also iconic, usually styled neatly with a slight bounce, perfectly framing her face and adding to her elegant appearance.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. Throughout her life, she focused on her sons and committed herself to charity work, like speaking out against land mines. Diana used her fame to bring attention to this and other important issues. This well-researched show takes a closer look at one of the 20th century's most amazing people. With never-before-seen footage, it shows her path from a shy teen to becoming the beloved Diana, Princess of Wales, including touching moments from her last days.

programme.desc: On this episode of Against the Odds, we salute the superstars of tennis, celebrating the off court bravery of Martina Navratilova, the relentless winning of Novak Djokovic, and the all round greatness of the man who ushered in the modern professional era, Rod Laver.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E36 - Eric Cantona, Marta, Shinji Kagawa
programme.desc: Eric Cantona battled his own demons and teammates to become one of the best football players of the 90s, Marta took on prejudice and unequal pay to win a better place for women in world football, and Shiji Kagawa scored his way from Japan’s second division to reach the glamour of Manchester United.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E33 - Nicola Adams, Refugee Olympic Team, and Abebe Bikila
programme.desc: Nicola Adams became the first woman to win Olympic boxing gold, and then the first woman to do it twice, the Refugee Olympic Team escaped war and social disintegration to fulfill their dream of competing at the Olympics, and Abebe Bikila shocked the world by winning marathon gold and breaking the world record in 1960 without shoes.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E35 - Amanda Nunes, Conor McGregor
programme.desc: Amanda Nunes beat every single women’s champion in her divisions’ history to become the greatest female fighter ever. Conor McGregor took over the world’s biggest fight promotion in only a few brief years before crossing over to boxing to face the greatest boxer of all time in the biggest fight in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E34 - Fanny Blankers-Koen, Carl Lewis, Mia Hamm, Babe Didrikson
programme.desc: Fanny Blankers Koen didn’t let war or children stop her from winning a record gold medal haul, Carl Lewis matched a fifty year old Olympic record and then surpassed it, Mia Hamm brought US soccer from a marginal curiosity to the front of the Olympic stage, and Babe Zaharias became the best at everything when she was expected to be nothing at all.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E28 - Tyson Fury, Randy Turpin, Claressa Shields
programme.desc: Tyson Fury defeated two of the scariest boxers in history and his own inner demons to become the heavyweight champion of the world - twice. Randy Turpin overcame the greatest boxer of all time at the height of his powers and Claressa Shields persevered through the most violent city in America to shough female boxers a new definition of success.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E29 - Magic Johnson, Becky Hammon, Yao Ming
programme.desc: Magic Johnson proved to everyone that HIV wasn’t a death sentence by flourishing in his post-playing career. Becky Hammon was told the most she could hope for was a college scholarship, so she became the first female coach in the NBA, and Yao Ming silenced his critics by becoming the most popular NBA player in the world.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E13 - Rooney, England, Charlton, Three Lions, Manchester United, Ballon d'Or
programme.desc: Bobby Charlton. One of England’s many heroes of 1966. A man who overcame so much to achieve great things. While the World Cup is revered by all who grace its stage, France self-destructed in 2010 in a manner unimaginable. And while he may have never won a World Cup, Chile’s Claudio Bravo made his nation proud on the Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E11 - World Cup 2014, Lahm, Beckenbauer, Germany, Bayern Munich, Guardiola
programme.desc: The quiet, unassuming character of Germany’s Philipp Lahm - one of the best Germany has seen. The 1998 World Cup in France - one with some of the best storylines. Paraguayan goalkeeper José Luis Chilavert didn’t shy away from creating his own legacy. Whether is big a footprint as Alf Ramsey, or as small as Paul the Octopus, it all happened on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E05 - Pelé, Stockholm, Sweden, Eisenhower, The Beatles, World Cup 1958
programme.desc: The story of Pelé taking the World Cup by the scruff of the neck at the age of 17 is legend. And we all know what we went on to do after that. On the cusp of reunification, West Germany triumphed in 1990, while a couple of French legends helped their nation to the peak of World Cup glory in 1998. It’s all in this installment of Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E12 - Zidane, Materazzi, World Cup 2006, Jacques Chirac, Czech Republic, Zizou
programme.desc: As we traverse the history of the World Cup, we revisit the wizard that was France’s Zinedine Zidane, and look back on Brazil’s Cafu, whose destiny on the world stage seemed preordained. programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E24 - Nadia Comaneci, Jessica Ennis-Hill
programme.desc: This week on Against The Odds . . . the perfect gymnast. Nadia Comaneci was the first to score a perfect ten in the Montreal Olympic Games. But her life in Romania away from the spotlight was far from perfect. Until she found her escape. Plus the face of the London Olympics, Jessica Ennis-Hill.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E17 - Martina Navratilova, Novak Djokovic, Rod Laver
programme.desc: On this episode of Against the Odds, we salute the superstars of tennis, celebrating the off court bravery of Martina Navratilova, the relentless winning of Novak Djokovic, and the all round greatness of the man who ushered in the modern professional era, Rod Laver.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E36 - Eric Cantona, Marta, Shinji Kagawa
programme.desc: Eric Cantona battled his own demons and teammates to become one of the best football players of the 90s, Marta took on prejudice and unequal pay to win a better place for women in world football, and Shiji Kagawa scored his way from Japan’s second division to reach the glamour of Manchester United.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E35 - Amanda Nunes, Conor McGregor
programme.desc: Amanda Nunes beat every single women’s champion in her divisions’ history to become the greatest female fighter ever. Conor McGregor took over the world’s biggest fight promotion in only a few brief years before crossing over to boxing to face the greatest boxer of all time in the biggest fight in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E34 - Fanny Blankers-Koen, Carl Lewis, Mia Hamm, Babe Didrikson
programme.desc: Fanny Blankers Koen didn’t let war or children stop her from winning a record gold medal haul, Carl Lewis matched a fifty year old Olympic record and then surpassed it, Mia Hamm brought US soccer from a marginal curiosity to the front of the Olympic stage, and Babe Zaharias became the best at everything when she was expected to be nothing at all.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E26 - Jose Mourinho, Bert Trautmann
programme.desc: This time on Against the Odds . . . the Special One, Jose Mourinho, who has managed many of the best clubs in football and won trophies wherever he’s gone, and one of Manchester City’s all-time greats, goalkeeper Bert Trautmann, and his courageous performance in the 1956 FA Cup Final.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E15 - Ayrton Senna, Alain Prost
programme.desc: They were the key players in a golden era of Formula One, the fascinatingly flawed Brazilian genius Ayrton Senna and his great rival, the meticulous Frenchman Alain Prost.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E22 - Johan Cruyff, Neymar
programme.desc: On this episode of Against the Odds we salute two of the most mercurial footballers the game has even known, the era-defining Johan Cruyff and Brazil superstar Neymar.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E30 - Leicester City FC, US Women’s National Soccer Team, Iceland
programme.desc: Leicester City were almost relegated in their first year back in England’s Premier League, the next year they won the entire competition. Megan Rapinoe and the US Women’s National Soccer Team took on prominent social issues while taking on the world’s best teams. Iceland were the smallest county to ever qualify for a major finals and ended up beating one of the giants of international football.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E27 - Luka Modric, Lucy Bronze, George Best
programme.desc: Luka Modrić rose out of abject poverty during the Croatian War of Independence to become his nation’s greatest player.Lucy Bronze emerged from the solitude of the Holy Island of Lindisfarne to become England’s most decorated Lioness.And George Best grew up on the streets of troubled Belfast to become the footballer every Irishman loved.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E32 - Billie Jean King, Arthur Ashe, Kim Clijsters
programme.desc: Billie Jean King battled the establishment to elevate the women’s game to new heights, Arthur Ashe overcame racism and a compromised heart to fight for positive change across a broad spectrum of causes, and Kim Clijsters came back from the physical rigours of childbirth to become the most successful tennis mother in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E13 - Christiano Ronaldo, Zinedine Zidane, Eusebio
programme.desc: In this episode of Against the Odds, we look at the brilliant career of Ronaldo, perhaps the only Brazilian footballer to rival Pele; we examine Zinedine Zidane as a player and a manager who reached the top in both fields; and we pay tribute to 1960s legend Eusebio.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain’s Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. Dino Zoff, the man who inspired Italy to victory in 1982 is another great tale. Then there’s the fun and games of Vuvuzelas, Mexican Waves and WAGS. There’s much to discuss on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football’s Greatest Stage
programme.desc: A World Cup hero for West Germany, Franz Beckenbauer is enshrined in his country’s football folklore. A captain turned coach, Dunga inspired Brazil to glory in 1994, but came up heartbreakingly short in 2014. And Gordon Banks - who kept it clean for England on the way to greatness in 1966. That’s this week, on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E01 - Platini, Pele
programme.desc: Beauty is a defining characteristic on football’s greatest stage, certainly present in the careers of France’s Michel Platini and Italy’s Paolo Maldini. There was an element of the beautiful and the ugly for Brazilian coach Luiz Felipe Scolari. Pelé speaks for himself, but he had special sidekicks, too. And Germany’s goalkeeper Sepp Maier was the man in 1974, on Football’s Greatest Stage.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E07 - Cruyff, Ajax, Barcelona, 1974 World Cup, Total Football, Netherlands
programme.desc: From a Dutch footballing legend who made his name at the World Cup, to the greats of the game who never set foot at the world’s biggest tournament. We cast an eye over England’s fabled 1966 triumph, and a revered German manager - an apprentice who became a master on Football’s Greatest Stage
